svg.title: A zsh session in a terminal window of 56 by 11 characters, at the prompt of the user mtorun0x7cd. whoami prints mtorun0x7cd; git config user.name prints Mert Torun; cat focus.txt prints Verification of Safety-Critical Systems and Information Security; ls works/ lists bachelors-thesis, masters-thesis and working-paper. A cursor rests at the next prompt. Below the window, two labels read Research & Development and @mtorun0x7cd.
